businessGroups.name: Account and Auth
businessGroups.data: Auth identity/session/recovery state; user/Auth IDs, name/email/phone/avatar, language/timezone, status and activity timestamps.

businessGroups.export: Deletion archive contains identity/status, impact and lifecycle events; not a complete Auth/session/social/Tax subject-access package.
businessGroups.erasure: 30-day pending schedule; due finalization neutralizes covered profile fields, clears covered security state and disconnects links. Completion requires Storage tasks and hard Auth deletion. Stable users.id and limited lifecycle/recovery references remain.
businessGroups.retention: 30 days is a pending period, not an exact all-copy removal deadline. Notification email cleanup after completion is worker-dependent. Backup/provider log retention is unknown.
businessGroups.role: Reylumi determines direct-account purposes; infrastructure provider treatment requires actual agreements and configuration.

businessGroups.name: Customers, booking and visits
businessGroups.data: Customer name/phone/email and customer/account IDs; private/internal/staff notes; service/staff/time/status/cancellation/visit history and payment-policy snapshots.
businessGroups.access: Authorized salon roles and linked customer/self paths through RLS/RPCs. Public salon availability does not make customer notes public.
businessGroups.export: Permission-selected customer/booking domains in salon archive, including notes. Personal archive only includes owned salon archives, not every salon relationship.
businessGroups.erasure: Account deletion releases customer_user_id but retains salon customer contact/notes/history and released_user_id metadata. Structural booking/transaction history survives.
businessGroups.retention: No universal end date or automatic general notes-minimization job established. A business label does not establish that every note is legally necessary.
businessGroups.linked: Yes: customer contact and booking relations identify people without an active app login.
businessGroups.role: Salon chooses service/customer purposes; instructed Reylumi processing is plausible with actual contractual and factual limits. Direct personal-account purposes remain separate.

businessGroups.name: Staff directory and scheduling
businessGroups.data: Legal/display name, phone/email/address/city/state/postal code, job title, account/Auth links; availability/time-block reasons/service assignments; public photo/bio/specialties/consent flags.
businessGroups.access: Salon management/permission scopes and own linked staff paths; selected public profile fields depend on profile settings/consent. Payroll has additional restrictions.
businessGroups.export: Selected roster/availability/assignments/time blocks in salon staff domain; not every staff or HR field.
businessGroups.erasure: Account links and public bio/photo/visibility/posting are cleared. Directory names/contact/address and business scheduling/payroll records remain.
businessGroups.retention: No automatic general staff-contact/address end date established. Public-profile withdrawal is distinct from business-record deletion.
businessGroups.role: Salon operational purposes plus separately enabled public profile/community presentation; allocate roles by actual purpose.

businessGroups.name: POS, receipts and financial corrections

businessGroups.erasure: Canonical closed business transaction/audit structures survive personal deletion. Removing a profile or social review does not remove the underlying sale.

appleCandidates: Payment Info (form-of-payment candidate; inspect actual fields)
businessGroups.linked: Yes where customer, employee or operator identities attach.
businessGroups.role: Salon sale/reconciliation purposes; processor/settlement role cannot be inferred from bookkeeping.

businessGroups.name: Payroll and paystubs

businessGroups.access: Owner/payroll-authorized roles; restrictive RLS limits Staff to own staff rows. Current connected Tax handoff returns selected published-period report fields, not a general raw-settings grant.

nativeFlows.name: Location / GPS
nativeFlows.data: Exact latitude/longitude, resolved city/state/ZIP; request IP at network boundary.
nativeFlows.path: getCurrentPosition → first-party POST /api/explore/area → server MapTiler if key, else/fallback Census. Exact coordinates also occur in scoped sessionStorage cache key; server bounded memory cache hashes exact inputs.
nativeFlows.linking: First-party request carries session context. Resolver does not write GPS to account/disk. This does not establish provider/hosting non-retention or unlinked status. highAccuracy:false does not make returned coordinates coarse.

nativeFlows.name: Maps / address search / directions
nativeFlows.data: Map viewport/tiles/IP; typed address/area query; salon street/city/state/ZIP; destination address/coordinate in external link.
categories: Physical Address where personal address is provided
nativeFlows.path: Client MapLibre → MapTiler maps/styles; first-party server → MapTiler geocoding/Census; explicit directions → Apple/Google Maps.
nativeFlows.linking: Direct tiles expose client network metadata; server geocoding exposes server IP plus query/coordinates. External destination handling belongs in provider review.

nativeFlows.name: Account / session / security
nativeFlows.data: Auth access/refresh cookies and user ID; login IP, user agent, OS/device label, coarse city/region/country; signed random app/browser identifier and HMAC abuse signals.
categories: Device ID candidate for app/browser pseudonymous identifier
nativeFlows.path: WK default cookies ↔ first-party server → Supabase Auth/DB. Native bridge forwards applicable origin cookies; browser Supabase client may connect directly.
nativeFlows.linking: Login activity explicitly stores user_id with IP/UA. Pseudonymous device cookie is not IDFA or hardware identifier; hashing does not establish anonymity.

nativeFlows.name: Native read cache / POS outbox
nativeFlows.data: Authorized read envelopes, account/workspace/salon scopes, customer/business/POS display data, queued operation bodies; device-only encryption keys.
categories: Inherit actual customer/business payload categories; local storage alone is not server collection
nativeFlows.path: App Support encrypted read files; AES-GCM body blobs in SQLite; Keychain AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly; file protection/backup exclusion. Native display cache separate from command queue; outbox sends authorized operations when permitted.
nativeFlows.linking: Locally scoped to account/workspace/salon authority. Encryption does not remove personal/business data. Queued operation becomes collection when transmitted.

nativeFlows.name: WKWebView / browser storage / draft recovery
nativeFlows.data: Persistent first-party cookies/website data; session browsing state; unresolved post request UUID, frozen caption/input/media paths; GPS preference and exact-coordinate cache key.
categories: User Content/Identifiers when submitted; local-only retention reviewed separately
nativeFlows.path: WKWebsiteDataStore.default; bounded sessionStorage experience state and unresolved post receipts; manual-location localStorage read/removal remains reachable.
nativeFlows.linking: Receipt is author/profile/salon-scoped and not anonymous. No File/Blob/access token stored by helper. SessionStorage lifetime on actual WK app restart must be checked; do not imply indefinite durability.

nativeFlows.name: Sponsored ads / attribution / discovery
nativeFlows.data: HMAC IP/visitor identifier; campaign/session/path/audience/mobile-desktop; impression/click time; signup conversion user ID; guest UUID or signed-in Explore user key.
purposes: Third-Party Advertising candidate for sponsored salon advertiser
nativeFlows.path: First-party cookies → ad API → Supabase campaign/impression/events; advertised external destination may leave origin.
nativeFlows.linking: Signup conversion explicitly passes p_user:user.id. No-IDFA/native-ad-SDK search does not settle tracking=false; cross-company combination/provider use must be evidenced separately.
nativeFlows.proof: source_confirmed; tracking/sale-share classification and operational retention unknown

nativeFlows.name: Local diagnostics / hosting logs / anti-abuse
nativeFlows.data: Bounded timing/status/category, allowed command name and random request UUID; app/build/bundle/time in manual report. Server separately records user-linked login/security IP/UA and errors.
purposes: Analytics only as actual diagnostic/processor practice supports
nativeFlows.path: Native transport defaults local diagnostics enabled. User chooses Save/Share; no automatic report upload. First-party requests carry request UUID; server/hosting have independent logging.
nativeFlows.linking: Native report allowlist rejects account/device IDs, URLs, cookies and business payloads. Server security logs explicitly link user ID. Do not conflate local diagnostic privacy with server retention.
nativeFlows.proof: source_confirmed; live hosting logs/drains/provider retention unverified

nativeFlows.name: Payments / email / SMS

nativeFlows.linking: Orders and delivery records can link to account/salon/recipient. Raw card data in provider UI does not mean app collects no financial information.
nativeFlows.proof: source_confirmed; enabled products/live-test mode/delivery/provider retention unknown

nativeFlows.name: In-app notifications / background refresh / push boundary

nativeFlows.path: Authenticated app_notifications DB reads and /api/notifications polling; BGTaskScheduler read-refresh for native cached models. These are separate from APNs remote notifications.

nativeFlows.proof: source_confirmed; no native or web PushManager/Notification.requestPermission registration found in searched app/components/lib/public/native source; physical delivery/lifecycle unverified
